prior.content:
ES Editions Watch — es-editions-watch

**November 24, registry 1.5.2.** Four of six sections passed the source and reader checks on both public domains, including reopened HTML and printed PDFs. Licensing and AI capabilities remain deferred for release acceptance. The scheduler reused the run ID with a new start at **16:56:48.669386 Eastern**. Its visible result still belonged to an earlier run. [Source audit](https://github.com/LeiterConsulting/splunk-version-value-explorer/blob/c9c0753eb6dd6f68dd6248914e907f5d8d49f79f/docs/audits/2026-11-24-es-editions-watch-review-5-sources.json) · [Coverage receipt](https://github.com/LeiterConsulting/splunk-version-value-explorer/blob/c9c0753eb6dd6f68dd6248914e907f5d8d49f79f/docs/audits/2026-11-24-es-editions-watch-review-5-coverage.json)

The candidate explains why an active Cloud Connected Premier trial displays Essentials and states that Alpha Threat Graph needs about one million processed events before it creates any findings. Both corrections passed the local screen, reopened HTML and PDF checks. genui{"citation":{"refs":["turn682677201view0","turn682677201view1"]}}

**06:15 handoff:** Draft PR #294 is at `c9c0753eb6dd6f68dd6248914e907f5d8d49f79f`. Its feed checkpoint adds two findings and 15 assessments, with all 120 prior checkpoints retained. Full local validation passed. The owner CI browser checks passed, but its pricing-page request returned HTTP 403. Exact-head application CI and export artifact verification remain open. The candidate is held for integration and the 09:00 steward’s release decision and public recheck. [Draft PR #294](https://github.com/LeiterConsulting/splunk-version-value-explorer/pull/294) · [Validation and feed handoff](https://github.com/LeiterConsulting/splunk-version-value-explorer/blob/c9c0753eb6dd6f68dd6248914e907f5d8d49f79f/docs/audits/2026-11-24-es-editions-watch-review-5-handoff.json)

scopeOutcomes.qualification: The 8.8 aggregate Triage/Response compatibility requires Premier, paired SOAR and Platform 10.2+ with ES 8.6+ on Cloud. The current linked Triage and Autonomous Response guides specify ES 8.7+, retaining the higher detailed minimum. The parent 8.8 setup guide now describes 200 analyses per tenant per day and 20 revisions per investigation; the linked Triage guide still limits coverage to existing/first ten findings and no rerun. Response remains Controlled Availability, Cloud-only in its availability column beside CMP compatibility bullets, and only frontier models are supported. Asset-role and connector/action permissions remain essential. The older 8.7 setup, SAIA 2.3.6 installer and regional/edition tables were checked within their own historical/product scope. No exact pairing, regional rollout or tenant authorization is inferred.

assessments.evidence: Essentials lists Security Assistant on Cloud where available, while Premier also lists Cloud Connected CMP. The ES 8.8 setup requires Platform 10.4+, ES 8.8+, Cloud Connect 2.0+ and SAIA 2.4+. The 2.4 installer requires fresh setup, a qualifying paid license, outbound HTTPS, STC/OAuth certificate, administrator capabilities, verified email domain and a supported AWS commercial region. The 2.3.6 installer excludes its new Cloud Connected route; installation and actual feature eligibility remain distinct.
assessments.qualification: Assistant edition, entitlement, Cloud/CMP and exact enablement prerequisites.

assessments.evidence: Detection Builder is both editions, Cloud and Cloud Connected CMP. The exact 8.8 task has Cloud Platform 10.1+/ES 8.6+ and CMP Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0+ floors. It is disabled for finding-based detections, and the ES agentic setup adds SAIA 2.4+. This is not a permission to save, clone, test or enable detections automatically.
assessments.qualification: Detection Builder Cloud/CMP, version, edition, stage and setup prerequisites.

assessments.evidence: The aggregate SOP row is both editions on Cloud only and requires the Security AI Assistant plus view/edit response-template capabilities. The response-plan guide separately describes import and conversion, formats and supporting workflows; inclusion does not establish tenant or regional activation.
assessments.qualification: SOP deployment, edition and Assistant dependency.

assessments.evidence: The exact 8.8 task labels Threat Graph an alpha for Premier and requires at least one enabled risk-based detection and approximately one million events before findings. assessments.qualification: Threat Graph documented stage, prerequisites, eligibility and enablement.

issueObservations.rationale: The 8.7 aggregate includes Essentials and Premier whereas 8.7.1 release notes label Connector Builder Premier. The 8.8 statement does not resolve the historical same-version conflict.

The matrix’s Premier enhancement grouping and the older Cloud task describe different release and feature scopes. The current 8.8 aggregate explicitly lists both editions and Cloud Connected CMP without rewriting the older entitlement question.
The 8.8 aggregate lists ES 8.5+ while the 8.8 task requires ES 8.6+ with Platform 10.2+ and paired SOAR. Preserve the higher task requirement and disagreement.
The App for SOAR 8.8 tested table still includes the literal malformed on-premises version 8..0. The two Export prerequisites use different explicit package rows. No unsupported tuple is inferred.

The ES pricing overview advertises activity, workload and ingest options. The detailed activity-based pricing FAQ applies to Cloud Platform and excludes self-managed Enterprise. Preserve unresolved ES deployment and contract eligibility.

The current Triage row and editions overview identify Premier with separate Cloud and Cloud Connected prerequisites; the historic lower-edition statement remains dated. Current pairing, activation and customer entitlement remain separate.

The 8.8 aggregate gives Cloud ES 8.6+, whereas the detailed Triage and Autonomous Response tasks give ES 8.7+. The parent now focuses on credits and revisions rather than replacing the task-specific prerequisites.

The aggregate Autonomous Response availability column says Premier Cloud only while its compatibility bullets describe a CMP minimum. The detailed task also describes CMP. Availability remains unresolved for that intersection.

The parent permits 200 daily analyses and 20 daily revisions per investigation, while the linked task retains finding-based quotas, first-ten coverage and no rerun. These same-version descriptions remain distinct.

The separate Autonomous Response task still disallows rerun and picking up newly added findings after processing, and supports frontier models only. Parent Triage revisions do not clear Response limits.

The 8.8 licensing topic preserves working Cloud Connected features during a Premier trial with the displayed tier remaining Essentials until the paid license updates. The public trial guidance retains that display distinction and the expiry conditions.

The current Threat Graph alpha task requires an enabled risk-based detection and approximately one million processed events before findings. The actual AI report contains this prerequisite and separate feature/release-stage qualification.

deferredConcerns: The 06:15 integrator reconciles the exact checkpoint with concurrent owner candidates. Maintain VersionCompass GitHub owns exact application export acceptance and subsequent public reader recheck. Review November 25.
issueFeed.qualification: Scoped records appended on the public owner branch after pinning the source receipt. Canonical feed activation, Site selection and public reader acceptance are separate.
